subject: Add integration tests for maxmemory scenarios and replication correctness. Fixed others tests and updated the build.sh script for running single integration tests (#16)
reason: The change is tests and build tooling only. The sole source modification (src/bloom/command_handler.rs) rewrites three match arms from Ok(_)/Ok(_v) to Ok(()), a semantically identical pattern-match style change on a Result<(), E> with no behavioral effect. Everything else adds pytest integration tests (maxmemory, replication), fixes test helpers that previously swallowed assertions, and adds a TEST_PATTERN option to build.sh. Nothing in the module's runtime behavior changed, so there is no changed path for a scenario to reach.
